Step 1 record mass of tube A when empty Step 2 place a sample of hydrated barium chloride crystals in tube A and record new mass Step 3 heat tube A Step 4 allow tube A to cool and record mass Repeat steps 3 and 4 until the mass recorded in step 4 is constant.
